title: re-armed surface: stale stamp then fresh stamp -> the LATEST trusted marker wins -> dor=verified

issue.title: security(intake): issue body TOCTOU between DoR approval and implement dispatch
issue.body:
## Summary

Intake evaluates DoR on the issue body at label time; implement re-fetches title+body at dispatch time.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Body edits after DoR approval are detected before the engine run
- [ ] Drift is surfaced to maintainers via label + comment
